info.name: PujariDekho — CRM + Pandit App + Customer Auth + App support (merged backend)
info.description:
Covers the endpoints added/merged into apps/api for: the CRM backoffice (salespeople + inquiries, migrated from the old standalone pujaridekhocrm/backend), the pujaripandit_app mobile backend, and customer auth used by pujariuser_app. All routes are mounted under {{base_url}} which should already include /api/v1, e.g. http://localhost:4000/api/v1 for local dev, or https://pujaridekho.com/api/v1 in production (served off the main domain at /api, reverse-proxied to apps/api — no separate subdomain).

Tokens: run the relevant *Login* request first — each has a test script that saves the returned token into the matching collection variable (crm_token / pandit_token / customer_token) which every other request in that folder uses automatically via Bearer auth.

item.name: Assign pandit to a specific event

exec: if (d && d.data) { if (d.data.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('customer_token', d.data.accessToken); if (d.data.refreshToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('customer_refresh_token', d.data.refreshToken); }

item.name: App support — settings, audio, devices & push (Nov 2026)
item.description: Endpoints for the Pujari Dekho app update check, pooja audio and push notifications. All responses use the { success, data } envelope.

request.description: Admin JWT for the admin endpoints below.

item.name: Get settings (public) — includes app version block

request.description: Returns maintenanceMode, maintenanceMessage and app: { android: {minVersion, latestVersion, storeUrl}, ios: {...}, updateMessage }. Defaults are always present.
Versions must be x.y.z and latestVersion >= minVersion, otherwise 400.

item.name: Get pooja by slug — includes active audios

request.description: audios: [{ _id, title, language, url, durationSec, sortOrder, isActive }] — only active clips, sorted by sortOrder.

item.name: Get festival by slug — includes active audios

request.description: MP3 / M4A, max 10 MB. Returns { url, durationSec } (duration from Cloudinary). Save the clip with PATCH /admin/poojas/:id { audios: [...] }.
Upsert by token (moves the token to this customer if it was registered by someone else); updates lastSeenAt. Response: { success, data: { token } }.
URL-encode the token. Only removes the caller's own token.
audience.type: all | city (city: 'Noida') | customer (customerId). Title ≤ 60, message ≤ 180, link must be a site path. Sent in 500-token batches; dead tokens are removed.
Approve → booking cancelled. Sends 'Booking cancelled' or 'Cancellation not approved'.
Approve → poojaDate/poojaTime set to the requested ones and reminders re-armed. Sends 'Booking rescheduled' or 'Reschedule not approved'.
